query: How do I reset my password?
expectedSnippet: To reset your password, visit the account settings page and click "Forgot password"

query: What does error code 0x7F3A mean?
expectedSnippet: ErrorCode 0x7F3A indicates the GPU driver crashed during inference

query: How are documents split into chunks?
expectedSnippet: Documents are split into overlapping chunks of 200 words with 20 words of overlap

query: Which model generates the answers?
expectedSnippet: default generation model is gemini-2.5-flash

query: How long do the auth tokens last?
expectedSnippet: JWT tokens that expire after 15 minutes

query: How does the app combine semantic and keyword search?
expectedSnippet: Hybrid search combines a vector store (LanceDB) for semantic matching with a BM25 index (MiniSearch) for exact keyword matching

query: Why are citations shown in the answer?
expectedSnippet: grounding is what makes the system trustworthy instead of a guessing machine

query: Which file types can I upload?
expectedSnippet: Supported file types are plain text, Markdown, and PDF

query: How do I avoid loading the reranker model on my own machine?
expectedSnippet: RERANK_PROVIDER=jina to call the Jina Reranker API instead

query: Where are the search indexes stored on disk?
expectedSnippet: The vector store lives in data/lancedb and the BM25 index lives in data/minisearch.json

query: What env var selects a different Gemini model?
expectedSnippet: GEMINI_MODEL environment variable to use a different Gemini release

query: What API key is required to run Recall?
expectedSnippet: only required key is GEMINI_API_KEY

query: Why is my first search so slow?
expectedSnippet: slow first query is normal

query: What happens if the reranker fails?
expectedSnippet: reranking fails, the server logs the error and falls back to the RRF ranking

query: The vector store and keyword index are out of sync, how do I fix it?
expectedSnippet: delete the document and re-upload it

query: What if answer generation fails?
expectedSnippet: Generation errors are streamed to the client as an error event

query: How do I fix out-of-memory errors while indexing?
expectedSnippet: index fewer or smaller documents at a time

query: Are my documents uploaded to third-party servers?
expectedSnippet: Recall is local-first: your documents are never uploaded to any third-party server

query: What gets sent to the Gemini API?
expectedSnippet: Only the final prompt is transmitted to the Gemini API, never your raw documents

query: Where are the model weights stored?
expectedSnippet: Model weights are cached in the .cache directory and stay on your machine

query: Does Recall collect telemetry?
expectedSnippet: Telemetry is off by default and no usage data leaves the device

query: What does the /api/search endpoint return?
expectedSnippet: POST /api/search streams Server-Sent Events containing sources, token, error, and done events

query: How do I upload a file via the API?
expectedSnippet: The upload route accepts a single multipart field named file

query: How do I delete a document through the API?
expectedSnippet: DELETE /api/documents expects a docId query parameter and removes all of its chunks

query: How can I list all indexed documents?
expectedSnippet: GET /api/documents lists every indexed document with its chunk count

query: What is the keyboard shortcut to focus search?
expectedSnippet: Cmd or Ctrl plus K focuses the search bar from anywhere in the app

query: What shortcut opens the upload dialog?
expectedSnippet: Cmd or Ctrl plus U opens the file picker to upload a document

query: Can I navigate citations with the keyboard?
expectedSnippet: Arrow keys move the focus between the cited source chunks

query: When was reranking introduced?
expectedSnippet: Version 1.4 added cross-encoder reranking after hybrid retrieval

query: When did streaming answers get added?
expectedSnippet: Version 1.2 shipped streaming answers with inline citations

query: What was in version 1.0?
expectedSnippet: Version 1.0 launched the local vector and BM25 hybrid search

query: How many dimensions are the embeddings?
expectedSnippet: The embedding model Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 outputs 384-dimensional vectors

query: Which reranker model runs locally?
expectedSnippet: The reranker Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 is a cross-encoder trained on MS MARCO

query: Why are the embeddings normalized?
expectedSnippet: Vectors are L2-normalized so cosine similarity equals the dot product

query: Can a team share one index?
expectedSnippet: Enterprise deployments can use a shared LanceDB object store for the index

query: Who is allowed to delete documents?
expectedSnippet: Role-based access control restricts who may delete documents

query: Is there an audit log of changes?
expectedSnippet: Audit logs capture every upload and deletion with a timestamp

query: Is there a Recall mobile app?
expectedSnippet: The mobile app mirrors the desktop index over the local network

query: Is mobile sync encrypted?
expectedSnippet: Mobile sync is protected by end-to-end encryption with a per-device key

query: Should I use smaller chunks?
expectedSnippet: Lowering the chunk size improves retrieval precision at the cost of context

query: How do I use GPU memory efficiently when embedding?
expectedSnippet: Batch embedding several chunks together uses GPU memory more efficiently

query: What does the RRF_K parameter do?
expectedSnippet: Increasing RRF_K makes the fused ranking depend more on high-rank agreement

query: What is the dimensionality of the sentence embedding vectors?
expectedSnippet: The embedding model Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 outputs 384-dimensional vectors

query: My GPU ran out of memory, which error code is that?
expectedSnippet: ErrorCode 0x7F3B, means the model ran out of VRAM

query: Can I run Recall without any internet connection at all?
expectedSnippet: Recall supports an air-gapped mode where the generation step is removed entirely

query: How do I pre-warm the models so the first search is fast?
expectedSnippet: You can pre-warm the models by issuing a dummy query at server start
